falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 6% above today's close within 14 days, with VIX closing below 14 on the same day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive risk-on breakout with crushed volatility would show this is not an unresolved bottom-like hold; the UNKNOWN/HOLD call would be wrong because the regime had already resolved bullish

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 5% below today's close within 14 days and VIX closes above 28 on that day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A fresh vol-shock drawdown would break the 78% bottom_2024_aug analog and prove HOLD wrong, because price and volatility would have confirmed an active risk-off regime rather than a stable unknown phase

falsification_conditions.condition: US high-yield OAS widens by 75 basis points or more versus today's close within 14 days, while the 10-year Treasury yield moves at least 40 basis points in either direction
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A joint credit-and-rates regime break would invalidate UNKNOWN/HOLD: macro stress or a rates shock large enough to force a directional call would have occurred, so standing aside as if the phase were still unidentified would be false

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
